literature_notes: L12 and L13 describe C-terminal tags (Twin-Strep/HA and FLAG) on full-length DAT. The authoritative topology places residues 579-620 as INTRACELLULAR; these sites are therefore disqualified as they are not on the extracellular face. L8/L9/L10/L11 describe HA and HA-βlactamase in EL2 of YFP-HA-DAT; L2 identifies the HA position as P194/G195 (the same junction as L3), so these clips add validation weight to site 1 but do not introduce a new site. The G199/S201 notation in L1 skips D200 in the canonical sequence (r(200)=D, r(201)=S); insert_after=199 is taken with G199 as the named anchor, acknowledging a one-residue uncertainty. The EL3 tetraCys (L5) places upstream cysteines at positions 286-287, only 1-2 residues from TM5 end (285); the tag body (PG) is at 288-289 (3 residues from TM5 end). This site is reported but ranked low due to TM proximity of the flanking cysteines.
